картина: Короткая справочная страница Google Cloud (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, раздел Safety) для разработчиков: что такое Content Credentials (C2PA), что они гарантируют и чего нет, как проверить, какие модели автоматически подписывают вывод. Основное содержание ~70 строк после огромного меню. Модели картинок: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-2.5-flash-image; плюс Omni, virtual-try-on, Veo, Lyria. Повторяющийся акцент: подпись автоматическая и от Google LLC; C2PA подтверждает источник и целостность, а не правдивость.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials provide a transparent look into the origin and history of media files such as images, video files, audio files, and documents.
единицы.цитата:
Content Credentials provide a transparent look into the origin and history of
media files, for example, images, video files, audio files, and documents.

единицы.утверждение_en: The C2PA technical specification for Content Credentials ('C2PA metadata') uses cryptographically signed metadata to provide secure, verifiable records of a media file's origin and changes; being signed, the information is tamper-evident.
единицы.цитата:
Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) is an open standards
organization that has developed a technical specification for Content
Credentials, called "C2PA metadata". This technology utilizes
cryptographically signed metadata to provide secure and verifiable records
of a media file's origin and any changes it's undergone. Being cryptographically
signed, this information is tamper-evident, helping you verify the authenticity
of the media asset.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials include information about the creation process, the tools used, and edits made to a media file; if an AI tool generates an image, the Content Credentials indicate that the image was AI-generated.
единицы.цитата:
Content Credentials include information about the creation process, the tools
used, and edits that were made to a media file. For example, if you use an AI
tool to generate an image, the Content Credentials will indicate that the image
was AI-generated.

единицы.утверждение_en: If you generate a media file such as an image using a supported Google model, Content Credentials are automatically added and signed by Google LLC.
единицы.цитата:
If you generate a media file, such as an image, using a supported Google model,
Content Credentials are automatically added and signed by Google LLC.
единицы.модели: не указано (поддерживаемые модели — в разделе Supported models)
единицы.заметка: Автоматически, без параметра запроса; способа отключить страница не называет.

единицы.утверждение_en: When viewing a file with Content Credentials in a C2PA-compatible application, you can see the file's history, such as the device, app, or service used to create and edit it.
единицы.цитата:
On the other hand, if you're viewing a file with Content Credentials in a
C2PA-compatible application, you can view the file's history,
such as the device, app, or service used to create and edit the file.

единицы.утверждение_en: C2PA doesn't classify media as 'real' or 'fake'; it authenticates the source of the information and ensures the content hasn't been tampered with, so even an AI-generated image is 'authentic' if it has valid Content Credentials describing how it was created or modified.
единицы.цитата:
Note that C2PA doesn't classify media as "real" or "fake". It
focuses on authenticating the source of the information and ensures that the
content hasn't been tampered with. Even an AI-generated image is regarded as
"authentic" if it has valid Content Credentials that describe how it was
created or modified.

единицы.утверждение_en: C2PA doesn't guarantee the truthfulness of the assertions in the Content Credentials; the consumer of the media file is responsible for deciding whether its source or owner is trustworthy.
единицы.цитата:
Moreover, C2PA doesn't guarantee the
truthfulness of the assertions in the Content Credentials. The consumer of the
media file is responsible for deciding whether the source or owner of file
is trustworthy or not.

единицы.утверждение_en: To verify the Content Credentials for a media file, go to the Content Credentials website.
единицы.цитата:
To verify the Content Credentials for a media file, go to the
Content Credentials website.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials are verifiable if the media file was created, edited, and published using only C2PA-aware tools.
единицы.цитата:
If the media file was created, edited, and published using only
C2PA-aware tools, the Content Credentials are verifiable.

единицы.утверждение_en: Any modification to a C2PA-compliant media file using a non-C2PA tool is considered tampering and results in a validation failure.
единицы.цитата:
Any modification to a C2PA-compliant media file using a
non-C2PA tool is considered tampering, resulting in a validation
failure.
единицы.заметка: Прямое следствие для пост-обработки сгенерированных картинок сторонними инструментами.

единицы.утверждение_en: All images or videos created or modified using the listed models are automatically digitally signed by Google LLC, with 'Google Media Processing Services' specified as the app or device used in the Content Credential.
единицы.цитата:
Content Credentials are supported by the following models. All images or
videos created or modified using the listed models are automatically digitally
signed by Google LLC. "Google Media Processing Services" is specified as the app
or device used in the Content Credential.
единицы.заметка: "created or modified" — подпись ставится и при редактировании.

единицы.утверждение_en: The Gemini image models supporting Content Credentials are gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image, gemini-3-pro-image, gemini-3.1-flash-image and gemini-2.5-flash-image.

Other models on the Content Credentials list are gemini-omni-1.1-flash-preview, gemini-omni-flash-preview, virtual-try-on-001, Veo 2.0/3.0/3.1 generate models, and lyria-3-clip-preview and lyria-3-pro-preview.
единицы.заметка: Цитата покрывает первые две строки (omni); virtual-try-on-001 (строка 1092), 13 id Veo (1093-1105), 2 id Lyria (1106-1107) перечислены в ведомости.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Images produced or edited by the Nano Banana models on this platform carry Google-signed C2PA Content Credentials automatically; to keep them verifiable, any later processing must use only C2PA-aware tools, because editing with a non-C2PA tool counts as tampering and fails validation.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сила оставлена "факт": страница описывает последствия, а не требует сохранять подпись.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: On this page Content Credentials are a provenance/integrity mechanism, not a truth or real-vs-fake classifier: they record that an image was AI-generated and by which service, and an AI image with valid credentials counts as 'authentic'.

противоречия_внутри: В разделе Supported models сказано 'All images or videos created or modified using the listed models are automatically digitally signed', но в списке есть музыкальные модели lyria-3-clip-preview и lyria-3-pro-preview (аудио), а вступление говорит о media files вообще, включая audio.
Блок What's next упоминает только 'Nano Banana and Nano Banana Pro', тогда как список поддерживаемых моделей содержит четыре image-модели (включая 3.1 Flash Image и 3.1 Flash-Lite Image).
не_сказано: Не сказано, можно ли отключить добавление Content Credentials.
Нет упоминания SynthID (невидимого водяного знака) — только C2PA-метаданные.
Не сказано, какие популярные инструменты являются C2PA-aware и что происходит при простом пересохранении/сжатии файла.
Не описано, в каком формате/поле файла хранятся креденшелы и как они ведут себя при выдаче через API (base64).
